summary: Over whatever email or calendar connector the owner has attached, Squire reads only through the tools he allowed, keeps drafts through the tools he classed as drafting, and every other tool waits for his yes; and what Squire decided and did is written to a record in his folder that he can read, with nothing secret in it.
title: Email and calendar through the owner's own connector, and the record of what Squire decided and did
